Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "test/fuzz.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 38, "var": "data", "code": "mg_mqtt_parse(data, size, 0, &mm);", "note": "Attacker-controlled raw input bytes are passed directly to mg_mqtt_parse as the MQTT message buffer with version 0."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "test/fuzz.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 40, "var": "data", "code": "mg_mqtt_parse(data, size, 5, &mm);", "note": "The same attacker-controlled input is passed to mg_mqtt_parse with version 5, enabling the MQTT v5 properties parsing path."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3250, "var": "buf", "code": "int mg_mqtt_parse(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, uint8_t version, struct mg_mqtt_message *m)", "note": "Entry point: buf points to the 7-byte input 0x30 0x05 0x00 0x00 0x80 0x80 0x80, len=7, version=5."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3260, "var": "m->cmd", "code": "m->cmd = (uint8_t)(buf[0] >> 4);", "note": "buf[0]=0x30, so m->cmd = 3 = MQTT_CMD_PUBLISH, selecting the PUBLISH parsing branch."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3264, "var": "n", "code": "n += (uint32_t)((lc & 0x7f) << 7 * len_len);", "note": "Remaining length byte buf[1]=0x05 is decoded: n=5, so end = p + 5 = buf + 7, exactly at the buffer boundary."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3272, "var": "end", "code": "end = p + n;", "note": "end = buf + 7, which equals buf + len, so the message is considered complete (not MQTT_INCOMPLETE)."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3288, "var": "m->topic.len", "code": "m->topic.len = (uint16_t)((((uint16_t) p[0]) << 8) | p[1]);", "note": "Topic length bytes buf[2]=0x00, buf[3]=0x00 decode to topic.len=0; p advances to buf+4."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3290, "var": "p", "code": "p += 2 + m->topic.len;", "note": "p = buf + 4. Since topic.len=0 and qos=0, no packet id is consumed. Now end - p = 3 bytes remain."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3303, "var": "p", "code": "if (version == 5 && p + 2 < end) {", "note": "version=5 and p+2 = buf+6 < end = buf+7, so the MQTT v5 properties branch is entered."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "mg_mqtt_parse", "line": 3304, "var": "m->props_size", "code": "m->props_size = decode_variable_length((char *) p, &len_len);", "note": "decode_variable_length is called with p = buf+4, but only 3 bytes (buf[4], buf[5], buf[6]) remain before end/buffer end."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "decode_variable_length", "line": 2966, "var": "p[offset]", "code": "encoded_byte = p[offset];", "note": "Loop reads p[0]=buf[4]=0x80 (continuation bit set), p[1]=buf[5]=0x80 (continuation bit set), p[2]=buf[6]=0x80 (continuation bit set)."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "mongoose.c", "function": "decode_variable_length", "line": 2966, "var": "p[3]", "code": "encoded_byte = p[offset];", "note": "offset=3: reads p[3] = buf[7], which is one byte past the end of the 7-byte heap buffer, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ of 1 byte."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written" && python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON')"` executed with exit code 0.
